summary: Aethlon Medical, a NASDAQ-listed Nevada surgical-device company, filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026 reporting an Agreement and Plan of Merger with privately held North Immunology, Inc. Under the two-step structure, Aethlon's subsidiary merges into North Immunology, which then merges into a second Aethlon subsidiary, making North Immunology a wholly owned subsidiary; the deal is intended as a tax-free Section 368(a) reorganization. Consideration is stock plus pre-funded warrants for holders breaching beneficial-ownership limits. No price, exchange ratio, premium or close date were disclosed; watch exchange-ratio terms and Nasdaq listing risk.
